desc.ian_image_library:title: Cephalopholis argus (Blue-spotted Grouper)
desc.ian_image_library:descr: Side view illustration of an adult Blue-spotted Grouper. The blue-spotted grouper was introduced to the Hawaiian islands from Moorea, French Polynesia in the late 1950s in an attempt to establish a grouper fishery in Hawaii.
